req.title: Reject non-positive redirect count
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the redirect count is zero or negative.

doc.reasoning: Fixing two violations: (1) test[0] was kind=negative with heuristic=BVA — BVA is only valid for boundary kind; changed to kind=boundary since n=0 is the exact boundary value. (2) test[4] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP — EP for a negative partition representative is valid, but the validator rejects negative+EP; changed heuristic to NEG which is the correct heuristic for negative equivalence class members. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_returns_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is configured with TESTING=True
actions: Send GET /redirect/0 using Flask test client
expected: Response status code is not 2xx (expect 500 due to AssertionError from assert n > 0)
trace: BVA: n=0 is the exact boundary value that violates n>0
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/0')
assert r.status_code == 500

tests.name: test_redirect_negative_one_returns_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is configured with TESTING=True
actions: Send GET /redirect/-1 using Flask test client
expected: Response status code is 500 (AssertionError from assert n > 0)
Status code is not 200, 302, or any 2xx/3xx
trace: NEG: n=-1 is a clearly negative value, well inside the invalid partition
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/-1')
assert r.status_code == 500
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 302

tests.name: test_redirect_one_succeeds_boundary_above_zero
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is configured with TESTING=True, follow_redirects=False
actions: Send GET /redirect/1 using Flask test client with follow_redirects=False
expected: Response status code is 302 (redirect issued, not an error)
trace: redirect_n_times() line: assert n > 0 passes for n=1
BVA: n=1 is the smallest valid value (boundary+1 above zero threshold)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.status_code != 500
assert r.status_code != 400

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_vs_one_status_codes_differ
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is configured with TESTING=True
actions: Send GET /redirect/0 and GET /redirect/1 and compare status codes
expected: The two status codes are not equal, confirming the boundary at n=1
trace: BVA: tests both sides of the n>0 boundary simultaneously
Catches > vs >= mutation: if assert changed to n >= 0, n=0 would not raise
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r_zero = client.get('/redirect/0')
r_one = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
assert r_zero.status_code == 500
assert r_one.status_code == 302
assert r_zero.status_code != r_one.status_code
